name: Stochastic Processes and Filtering
description: Basics of probability, stochastic processes, stochastic difference and differential equations, parameter estimation, Bayesian estimator, maximum aposteriori estimator, maximum likelihood estimator, Cramer-Rao lower bound, minimum mean-squared error estimator, best linear unbiased estimator, filtering, smoothing and prediction, Wiener filter, Kalman filter and its variations, non-linear filters, applications.
